assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: 京张铁路遗址公园二期于2026年8月建成开放、全线约9公里贯通 / Phase two of the Jing-Zhang Rail Park opened Aug 2026, connecting the full ~9 km.
assumptions.impact: 本方案「不重做这条线」的立场以此为前提；若建成范围不同，五处加厚的位置需重新判断 / The do-not-redo position rests on this; if extents differ, the five thickening points must be reassessed.

assumptions.statement: 沿线现存主要地面运行轨道与噪声源为地铁13号线，京张高铁已入地 / The principal remaining at-grade rail and noise source is Metro Line 13; the high-speed line runs underground.
assumptions.impact: 决定「沉」的对象与位置；须以实测噪声与轨道现状核校 / Determines the object and location of the sink move; requires measured noise and as-built survey.

assumptions.statement: 13号线扩能拆分后13A南段自大钟寺以南拨线，既有地面线位可能被释放 / After the Line 13 capacity split, the 13A southern section is realigned south of Dazhongsi, possibly releasing the existing at-grade alignment.
assumptions.impact: 通市段承接线位的建议依赖此规划；最终线位与时序须以官方发布为准，三期时序不可提前锁定 / The Market-segment alignment suggestion depends on this; final alignment and timing follow official releases.

assumptions.statement: 抬、沉、叠三类剖面动作均为概念性剖面策略 / Lift, sink, and stack are conceptual section strategies only.
assumptions.impact: 不构成桥隧、地下空间、结构或消防的工程可行性结论，须由专业团队按规范深化 / Not an engineering feasibility conclusion; must be deepened to code by professional teams.

assumptions.statement: 全部设计图层基于任务包临时替代边界生成 / All design layers are generated from the provisional surrogate boundary.
assumptions.impact: 场地面积、绿地率、公共空间占比均为设计模型输出，官方polygon发布后必须重算 / Core metrics are design-model outputs and must be recomputed on official polygons.
